versions.text: If induction system screens are used-- (a) Each screen must be upstream of the carburetor; (b) No screen may be in any part of the induction system that is the only passage through which air can reach the engine, unless-- (1) The available preheat is at least 100� F.; and (2) The screen can be deiced by heated air; (c) No screen may be deiced by alcohol alone; and (d) It must be impossible for fuel to strike any screen.
